A_continuity.current_commutes_with_the_link_signs: J_i(x) contains no link sign: the same operator in every link word

D_chiral_reading.statement: a charge q0 + q1 X_r (the handedness label of the chiral reading) has the on-site source q1 (M* X_r M - X_r) per tick; for Q6 the two classes differ by 3 and for n2 mod 2 by 1, so with the toggle neither is conserved and (-1)^(n2) in G_x does not commute with Gamma(M); the part that is conserved is the charge of the four levels other than the neutral doublet level
D_chiral_reading.statement_2: if only one handedness class sees the link sign, the sub-step is still a unitary conditional shift but S_i R is no longer an involution: the reflector form needs the same link sign on both arrow states. A label read in the record basis (Z_r) is changed by every sub-step.
